text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Tact, could you take me to the forest 
again? I just know there's something 
coming to the forest this season— a 
destined flow!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course. ...Fufu. A fateful flow of 
events, is it?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
So that's how you feel the forest, 
Epi-senpai. That's truly lovely.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, thanks! Out here in Mother Nature— I 
feel like I can see things way clearer 
than in the city. ...The flow of destiny, 
and all that.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I can hear the 'Voice of Destiny' clearly, 
too... I can feel through the air how 
everything is turning and connecting.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Well— ...yes, I think I understand what 
you mean.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I may not be able to hear it as words like 
you do, Senpai... but I can definitely 
feel it.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
The flow of the wind, the twinkling of the 
stars, the chirping of insects. I feel as 
though all of these things are trying to 
tell me something.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Maybe they're actually quite similar. The 
voice of nature, and that 'voice of 
destiny' you spoke of, Senpai.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
—! Ah... of course, that's it! Everything 
is connected—nature, and destiny too!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Aahhh, I'm so glad you get it! You're the 
only one who truly understands me, Tact!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I knew you were special! Tell me more! 
Everything about nature!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course. Please tell me more, too. 
—About the 'destiny' you feel, Senpai.
